**sdd/brain/testing-capabilities**

## Testing Capabilities

**Strict TDD Mode**: enabled
**Detected**: 2026-08-29 (refreshed; superseded 2026-07-02 baseline of 791 tests — test suite has grown substantially since)

### Test Runner

- Command: `npm test`
- Raw command: `node --test "brain/scripts/**/*.test.mjs" "test/**/*.e2e.test.mjs"`
- Framework: Node.js built-in test runner (`node:test`), zero external dependencies
- **Verified run (2026-08-29, worktree `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-456`)**: 4497 tests, 4497 pass, 0 fail, 0 cancelled, 0 skipped, 0 todo, duration_ms 27182 (~27.2s)
- Node version: v22.13.0

### Test Layers

| Layer       | Available | Tool        |
| ----------- | --------- | ----------- |
| Unit        | ✅        | `node:test`, colocated `*.test.mjs` under `brain/scripts/` |
| Integration | ✅        | `node --test "test/**/*.e2e.test.mjs"` (in-process e2e, part of `npm test`); plus Docker-based `npm run test:fresh-install` / `npm run test:upgrade` (require docker + VCS_TOKEN, not part of the fast loop) |
| E2E         | ✅        | Same e2e suite above (e.g. `brain-review` protocol e2e tests) — no browser/UI E2E in this repo (CLI harness, no UI) |

### Coverage

- Available: ❌
- Command: —

### Quality Tools

| Tool         | Available | Command                          |
| ------------ | --------- | --------------------------------- |
| Linter       | ❌        | — (no eslint/prettier detected)   |
| Type checker | ❌        | — (plain `.mjs`, no TypeScript)   |
| Formatter    | ❌        | —                                  |
| Repo checks  | ✅        | `npm run repo:check` (cross-refs + artifact structure), `npm run brain:nav` (nav graph integrity), `npm run brain:governance-status` (tier×rung doctrine), `npm run brain:audit` / `brain:check` (diffSize/issueLink/adrPresence/memoryPresence) |

### Why Strict TDD

Fast (`node --test`, ~27s for the full suite), zero external services, deterministic. No barrier to Strict TDD Mode. `openspec/config.yaml` was corrected this pass from a stale `strict_tdd: false` to `true` (see `sdd-init/brain` for detail).
